abstract: This paper investigates how a production transitional autonomous vehicle (tAV) develops and executes mandatory lane-change decisions. Using 150 controlled mandatory lane changes from the NC-tALC experiments, the study examines whether the eventual target gap is observable before lateral movement begins and how the tAV progresses longitudinally from that pre-lane-change state to lane-change start. Signal time (SigT) is defined as an operational pre-lane-change-start reference point. A Firth logistic regression predicts whether the tAV eventually merges in front of or behind its nearest target-lane vehicle using relative position and relative speed at SigT. Longitudinal progression from SigT to lane-change start is then examined separately for in-position and repositioning cases. The traffic state at SigT contains substantial information about eventual target-gap choice and provides meaningful lead time before lateral movement begins. The proposed formulation predicts whether the tAV remains with its current gap or repositions to a neighboring gap by moving forward or dropping back, including cases with longitudinal overlap and ambiguous current-gap geometry. The model achieves an average five-fold cross-validated accuracy of 0.89. Results also provide preliminary evidence that in-position and repositioning cases follow different longitudinal pathways from SigT to lane-change start. These findings support a two-stage conjecture of the observable lane-change process: longitudinal preparation from SigT to lane-change start, followed by lateral maneuver execution. The formulation applies to in-position, repositioning, and longitudinally overlapping cases, and can support lane-change models that distinguish target-gap choice from lateral-onset timing while representing longitudinal preparation before lateral movement begins.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种生产型过渡性自动驾驶车辆（tAV）如何制定和执行强制变道决策。通过分析150次来自NC-tALC实验的受控强制变道，研究探讨了在横向移动开始之前，最终目标间隙是否可观察，以及tAV如何从该预变道状态纵向推进到变道开始。信号时间（SigT）被定义为一个操作性的预变道开始参考点。使用Firth逻辑回归预测tAV最终是在其最近目标车道车辆前方还是后方合并，依据SigT时的相对位置和相对速度。然后分别对在位和重新定位的情况考察从SigT到变道开始的纵向进展。SigT时的交通状态包含关于最终目标间隙选择的重要信息，并在横向移动开始之前提供了有意义的提前时间。所提出的模型预测tAV是保持当前间隙还是通过向前移动或后退来重新定位到相邻间隙，包括纵向重叠和当前间隙几何形状模糊的情况。该模型的平均五折交叉验证准确率为0.89。结果还提供了初步证据，表明在位和重新定位的情况在从SigT到变道开始的过程中遵循不同的纵向路径。这些发现支持了可观察变道过程的两阶段假设：从SigT到变道开始的纵向准备，随后是横向机动执行。该模型适用于在位、重新定位和纵向重叠的情况，并可以支持区分目标间隙选择与横向开始时机的变道模型，同时表示在横向移动开始之前的纵向准备。

title: Pre-Lane-change Signal in Transitional Autonomous Vehicles: Results from Controlled Experiments
title_zh: 过渡性自动驾驶车辆中的预变道信号：来自受控实验的结果
